description: A job offer, posted by anyone. When the author's handle equals the company key (its domain), it is the company's own offer. Offers expire; renew to extend. Applications never go through joblist: `apply` says where to send them.

url.description: Where to read the offer: its page on the company's site or job board, or its joblist page. May equal the application link.

expiresAt.description: After this date the offer is no longer shown.

apply.description: How to apply. Applications go straight to the poster: joblist never receives them.

url.description: An application form (https://…) or an email address (mailto:…).

bluesky.description: Apply by sending a direct message to the poster's account on Bluesky.
